title: @require_world_size(4) macro is ambiguous or buggy
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

For the following test example : 
[  def test_new_subgroups_with_group_param(self):
](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/torch/testing/_internal/distributed/distributed_test.py#L924)            # Initialize global test environment
            self._init_global_test()
            # Set up GPU devices for each rank
            init_multigpu_helper(dist.get_world_size(), BACKEND)
            # Create two subgroups: one with ranks [0,2] and another with ranks [1,3]
            cur_subgroup, subgroups = dist.new_subgroups_by_enumeration(
                ranks_per_subgroup_list=[[0, 2], [1, 3]]
            )


As you can see the [0, 2] [1,3] was hard-coded, expecting the test to be world size of 4. 
However, recent enablement of 8B200 runner failed while running this unit test, e.g. https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/16764647752/job/47468897556 
Clearly, the world size was 8. 
Does the use of this macro guarantee the world size is 4, looks like no from the above failure. 

### Versions

main
